crypt: The dead here have been waiting a long time. I can feel them watching.
Stone and rot. Whatever sealed this place in, they sealed something worse in with it.
Even the silence here sounds like it's holding its breath.
moss: The dungeon is bleeding green down here. Living things don't belong in places like this.
Water finds its way through every crack. So do things that shouldn't exist.
The walls breathe. I've stopped pretending otherwise.
gallery: Someone arranged these halls like a cathedral. I wonder what they worshipped.
The stonework is too precise. Too deliberate. Something was meant to be displayed here.
Beautiful, in the way that traps are beautiful.
brick: Old construction. The kind built to last centuries and abandoned in decades.
These walls have absorbed too much. You can feel it pressing back against your torch.
Mortar and intention. Whoever built this knew exactly what they were building.
catacomb: Bones stacked like records. Every one of them died thinking they were the last.
The passages narrow here. The dead crowd close.
This is what accumulation looks like. Centuries of endings, stacked and shelved.
